construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, fixture_label, status, customer, question, knowledge, catalog, document_text, stages
shared_schema.input: status=ready, stages={}, fixture_label=synthetic; strict field sets
shared_schema.output: Same envelope; status=ok and four validated stage results
shared_schema.customer: id, name, email (empty allowed), goals[], interests[], budget_cents
shared_schema.knowledge: Objects containing id, keywords[], answer, tags[]
shared_schema.catalog: Objects containing id, name, tags[], price_cents, stock, active
shared_schema.document_text: Reference and Quantity required; Notes optional. Case-insensitive Field: value lines; duplicate and unknown fields rejected; quantity 1..1000.
shared_schema.money: Nonnegative integer USD cents; bools and floats rejected. Recommendation budget is per item; document total is checked against the same budget.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces all input and stage boundaries, ordered stage prefixes, and exact deterministic derived outputs. JSON duplicate keys/nonfinite constants are rejected by CLI.
shared_schema.limits: Input <=1,000,000 characters; <=1000 catalog/knowledge entries; <=100 tags/goals/interests; bounded strings and integers

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated customer identity and personalized next step; next step preserved in support result
Validated resolution, knowledge source IDs and topic tags; topic matches affect ranking
Validated top product, unit price, customer ID and support sources generate proposal lines

behavior.onboarding: Personal greeting and one next action: add contact, choose goal or explore first goal
behavior.support: Deterministic keyword-overlap retrieval over supplied synthetic knowledge only; verbatim grounded answer plus source ID, or explicit human-review fallback without claiming a submitted ticket
behavior.discovery: Exclude inactive, out-of-stock and over-budget products; rank tag overlaps (interest=3, goal=2, support=4), then price and ID; return up to 3 with transparent matched terms
behavior.documents: Extract key/value fields, reshape top recommendation into a synthetic proposal, calculate exact totals and flag total-budget/inventory/empty-selection issues; no order is submitted
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout; successful run exits 0, validation/file/encoding/JSON/usage errors exit 2 with status=error
behavior.immutability: Pipeline does not mutate caller input; all stage outputs checked before further use

included: Clearly labeled synthetic input and document output
Personalized onboarding, grounded offline support, explainable discovery
Structured extraction, rendered proposal text and review checks
Unittest fixtures and subprocess CLI checks
excluded: Ticket creation, outbound messages, payments or order submission
OCR, PDF parsing, arbitrary document formats
Persistent storage, authentication or production infrastructure
Semantic understanding beyond deterministic keyword matching

test_outcomes.cli: Verified example_input.json prints one JSON object with status ok
test_outcomes.coverage: All stages, all handoffs, ranking propagation, deterministic ties, tamper rejection, input immutability, missing contact/goals, support fallback, empty discovery, budget/inventory checks, invalid schemas/documents, CLI success/file/encoding/JSON/size/usage errors
